record.question: Patanjali is known for the compilation of which book?
record.explanation: Answer B: Yoga sutra. Patanjali is traditionally credited with compiling the Yoga Sutras. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Yoga-Sutras. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
